name: CIFAR-10 Training Methods
description: This paper introduces training methods for CIFAR-10 that achieve 94% accuracy in 3.29 seconds on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, along with methods targeting 95% and 96% accuracy.
creator: Keller Jordan
citeAs: Jordan, Keller. '94% on CIFAR-10 in 3.29 Seconds on a Single GPU.' arXiv:2404.00498v2 [cs.LG], 2024.
rai:dataCollection: The CIFAR-10 dataset contains 60,000 32x32 color images, labeled as one of ten classes, divided into a training set of 50,000 images and a validation set of 10,000 images.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data augmentation includes random horizontal flipping and 2-pixel random translation.
